title: open_instance
description: Open a new instance of an app or tool in a pane.
signature: pub fn open_instance(app: tauri::AppHandle, shell: State<ShellState>, label: String, app_id: String, pane_id: Option<String>, dir: Option<SplitDir>) -> Result<String>
semantics: Returns the new instance id; dir triggers a pane split up to the ceiling.
